decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins extend the firm's core data integration expertise and have their own page, so in-house R&D and standards work let it absorb feedback and keep improving them.

The building digital twin fits the strategic direction and draws on geospatial know-how and research ties, but its newer BIM knowledge base and its thin web presence leave some risk of it being folded in or dropped.
Authentication and identity delegation sits close to the firm's security components and is cheap to maintain, though it may be merged into the broader identity service.
The open GIS development framework is central to the strategy of open, extensible components, and the firm's developers and research capacity let it evolve the framework.
The identity service was actively promoted at launch and builds directly on the firm's platform integration knowledge, so continued development is likely.
The consulting workshop builds on decades of geodata process experience and certified trainers, and its own page shows commitment, so its early results are easy to learn from.
